name: skills_list
description: List available skills (name + description). Use skill_view(name) to load full content.

category.description: Optional category filter to narrow results

name: skill_view
description: Load a skill's SKILL.md, or one of its linked references, templates or scripts. The first call returns SKILL.md plus a 'linked_files' dict; call again with file_path to read one.

name.description: The skill name (use skills_list to see available skills). For plugin-provided skills, use the qualified form 'plugin:skill'.

file_path.description: OPTIONAL: Path to a linked file within the skill (e.g., 'references/api.md', 'templates/config.yaml', 'scripts/validate.py'). Omit to get the main SKILL.md content.

name: skill_manage
description: Create, update or delete skills: your procedural memory for recurring tasks. The operations apply atomically — any failure rolls every touched skill back. Ops: create (lands in the profile's skills directory or configured skills.create_dir; must precede that skill's other ops), patch (targeted old_string/new_string fix — preferred), write_file/remove_file (supporting files), delete (sole op only). Existing skills are modified wherever they live. Description: max 1024 chars, 'Use when <trigger>. <behavior>.', never the category name (the index shows it). Write lessons, not logs: imperative rule + why, no PR numbers/dates/incident narration, one rule per lesson, references/ named by topic (extend before adding). skill_view() shows format conventions.

operations.description: Ordered ops (a single edit is a list of one); each names its target skill (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Each action is its own shape; another action's text slot is invalid.

content.description: Full SKILL.md text (YAML frontmatter + markdown body).

old_string.description: Text to find (same matching semantics as the patch tool).

new_string.description: Replacement; empty string deletes the match.

file_path.description: Optional supporting file (write_file's shape); default SKILL.md.

content.description: Full SKILL.md rewrite (REPLACES the whole file; last resort — read it via skill_view() first).

file_path.description: Path RELATIVE to the skill's own directory, e.g. 'references/api.md' — no leading slash, never absolute; first segment references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/.

file_content.description: Full text of the supporting file.

absorbed_into.description: Curator consolidation only: umbrella skill that absorbed this one (must exist).
